title: MigrateMsg
description: Migration payload. Same `FromV1` / `Patch` split as [`choice_zap_lp`'s](../../choice_zap_lp) — `Patch` is constrained to in-major bumps so an admin can't silently rewrite `choice_factory` or `sink_code_id` via a v2 → v2 `MsgMigrateContract` with a v1-shaped payload. `FromV1` is wired so callers can compile against a stable migrate-msg shape before a real v1 → v2 schema delta exists.
